routing.question: Which route takes over when the primary provider fails?
routing.action: Click Kill Primary Provider. Read Route and the breaker countdown while the primary circuit is open.
routing.observe: Follow the fallback in the trace, then watch the primary become eligible again when the cooldown ends.

dyno.question: How do the two maps compare at the same RPM?
dyno.action: Pause the replay. Set one RPM with the slider, then switch between Base Map and Calibrated Map.
dyno.observe: Compare simulated torque, AFR and knock retard at that fixed RPM. Move the slider to see whether the difference persists.

ai-ops.question: Which part of your inference pipeline has the least evidence?
ai-ops.action: Rate all four controls and calculate readiness. Find the first priority and check its proposed fix against your usage ledger or replay logs.
ai-ops.observe: Verify one missing control, then change only that answer and recalculate. Compare the score and the order of the priorities.

linux-security.question: Which host control should you verify first?
linux-security.action: Rate each control using evidence from the host. Calculate readiness and compare the first priority with the last access or recovery review.
linux-security.observe: A partial control earns less than a verified one. Copy the report to record which evidence you still need.

auto-telemetry.question: Can you align both logs before comparing two pulls?
auto-telemetry.action: Review the time-reference question against the RPM landmarks in your two logs. Rate all four controls, then calculate readiness.
auto-telemetry.observe: Look for trace alignment in the priorities. Use the suggested fix to record the time offset before reviewing the overlays.
